status: Design targets; not measured performance or observed traffic

units.screen_size: CSS-equivalent pixels at 390 px viewport width; native pixels divided by viewport scale

style.name: Style B
style.color_space: sRGB authoring; interpolate in linear light
style.lighting: Inherit world-package sun/time/weather; no independent asset exposure or extra key lights

reference_light.source: visual-v2 section3.3 golden-hour values, illustrative studio reference only

near.features: Silhouette, bevels, wheels/limbs, up to2 large accent patches; no badges/handles/faces

mid.features: Body plus cabin/limb silhouette; merge tiny pieces; no wheel spokes or face detail

far.features: Single/simple colored silhouette, no small openings; no mesh upscaling

subpixel.action: Cull optional life; preserve required tracked entities via separate map/UI representation, not fake oversized world meshes

people_distance_examples_m.note: Illustrative only; projected size wins. Wheels, wing span and hull length use longest projected dimension; people use height.

shared_effects.note: Competing caps, not additive entitlements. Rain/snow/leaves share existing0.20ms weather bucket; all effects alpha area includes overlaps summed against screen area.

parked_road_max.note: Not additional triangle allowance. Count opaque geometry and submissions against same scene ceilings.

budget.note: Ambient targets replace headroom inside existing buckets; do not add0.35ms on top. All timings are hypotheses until ten-minute sustained device benchmark.

simulation.stable_seed: Use existing StableRandom/OSMRef + semantic salt; never per-frame randomness
simulation.speed_rule: Use verified live speed/route when available; generic ranges below are art priors, not legal limits
simulation.spawn_rule: Mapped navigable roads, footways, rail and water; respect lane direction/left-driving regional data, turn restrictions and accessible paths; never simulate known closures or private interiors
simulation.shelter_rule: Suppress splashes/sprinklers under known cover; reduce pedestrians in hazardous weather; never infer evacuation crowds
simulation.lifecycle: Fade optional population at spawn/despawn boundaries outside foreground; keep identity stable; no teleporting on camera motion
simulation.missing_live: Show ambient_synthetic label in accessible info; no implied exact private activity
simulation.emergency: Parked or rare slow-moving generic emergency vehicles only without entitled incident data; no invented emergency dispatch, flashing alarm or siren

effects.rule: Only eligible high-altitude flight and weather support; unknown defaults off. Screen-size cap and no weather forecast claim.
Hard wet surface only; small expanding procedural ring+1–2droplets; no black stain. Budget prioritizes visible falling rain.
Requires loose snow+wind; low sparse ribbons; never automatic drifting/plowing history.
Opaque simple2–6triangle leaves; deciduous leaf-fall season+wind; bounded near camera.
Known vent or explicitly synthetic decorative location; pale vertical puffs drift with wind; no fire/smoke claim.
Only existing plausible chimney; synthetic activity explicitly marked; not every house, never wildfire tint.
Optional synthetic sprinkler on eligible lawn; dry mild day only, off rain/freeze/drought restriction or unknown policy; no real household schedule claim.

shadow_policy.animals: Optional cheap contact treatment only inside existing shadow/contact bucket
shadow_policy.lights: Emergency housings nonflashing; global maximum2nearby unshadowed lights shared by entire scene
